zh.title: 蒙特婁機場（YUL）停機坪發生作業人員遭飛機撞擊重傷事故
zh.summary: 蒙特婁特魯多國際機場一名地勤人員遭飛機撞擊重傷；警方與工安單位展開調查
body: 加拿大蒙特婁皮埃爾·埃利奧特·特魯多國際機場於2026年8月24日晚間發生一起嚴重地勤事故。一名在停機坪作業的工作人員遭飛機撞擊受重傷，隨後被緊急送往醫院接受治療。機場營運機構蒙特婁機場（YUL）公司（Aéroports de Montréal，簡稱 ADM）證實，緊急應變程序於當地時間約 19:30 啟動，處理這起涉及飛機與機場工作人員的事故。

根據加拿大廣播公司（Radio-Canada）報導，受傷的工作人員是一名地面引導員（signaller），負責在停機坪引導飛機進出機位。蒙特婁市警局（SPVM）隨後證實該名人員傷勢嚴重。事故發生時，法國蜜蜂航空（French bee）一架註冊號碼為 F-HREY 的空中巴士 A350-900 客機正準備執行從蒙特婁飛往巴黎奧利機場（ORY）的 BF5761 班機。該航班原定於當地時間 18:00 起飛，但在事故發生後並未依計畫離港。
航班紀錄顯示，涉事的 A350-900 客機（F-HREY）先前於 2026 年 8 月 22 日晚間 21:27 執飛 BF760 班機抵達蒙特婁，其原定於當晚 23:00 返回巴黎的 BF761 航班遭取消，據報係因技術問題滯留。隨後，法國蜜蜂航空另派一架註冊號碼為 F-HREU 的 A350-900 客機執行預定的 BF761 航班，並於 8 月 25 日凌晨 00:11 起飛離港。
監管與調查處置方面，蒙特婁市警局表示，由於該起事件屬於職場工安事故，案件將移交魁北克省勞工健康與安全委員會（CNESST）接手調查。此外，加拿大運輸安全委員會（TSB）發言人亦證實調查人員已獲知該起事故，截至 8 月 25 日，TSB 尚未發布針對此事件的派員調查通知。機場營運商表示，整體機場營運在事故後仍持續運作，並建議旅客向航空公司確認最新航班動態。

en.title: Ground Worker Seriously Injured After Being Struck by Aircraft at Montreal Airport (YUL)
en.summary: French bee A350 incident at Montreal Trudeau Airport leaves ground signaller seriously injured; investigation underway.
body: A ground worker was seriously injured after being struck by an aircraft on the apron at Montreal-Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport (YUL) on the evening of August 24, 2026. Airport operator Aéroports de Montréal (ADM) confirmed that emergency services responded around 19:30 local time following the accident involving an aircraft and a member of the airport community. The injured employee was immediately transported to a hospital for medical treatment.

According to Radio-Canada, the worker was a signaller responsible for guiding aircraft on and off airport stands. The Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM) confirmed the individual sustained serious injuries. The incident occurred while French bee Airbus A350-900 (registration F-HREY) was preparing to operate flight BF5761 to Paris Orly Airport (ORY). The flight had been scheduled to depart at 18:00 local time but did not leave following the occurrence.

Flight records indicate that F-HREY had previously arrived in Montreal from Orly as flight BF760 on August 22 at 21:27. Its scheduled return leg, flight BF761, was canceled that evening due to a reported technical issue. French bee subsequently dispatched another Airbus A350-900, registered as F-HREU, to fulfill the scheduled BF761 service, which departed Montreal at 00:11 on August 25.

Because the event is classified as an industrial workplace accident, the SPVM stated the investigation will be transferred to Quebec’s workplace safety regulator, the Commission des normes, de l’équité, de la santé et de la sécurité du travail (CNESST). A spokesperson for the Transportation Safety Board of Canada (TSB) confirmed its investigators were notified of the incident, though no official deployment notice had been issued as of August 25. ADM stated that general airport operations continued normally and advised passengers to verify flight schedules with their respective airlines.
